[LCYC.3.3.3] A rule whose RHS both `emit`s a schema and `withdraw`s a
binding of the same schema is a one-rule SCC [LCYC.3.1.1] never admits
(the schema is emitted and matched by a rule of the SCC). The compiler
reports it at the RHS, as `DS_VALIDATE_WITHDRAW_EMIT_SAME_SCHEMA`,
rather than as a graph-cycle diagnostic.
